text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Moslems must engage in innovation and ideas rather than let Western scientific and technological advance shape the future.

-- The Malaysian cabinet will discuss at its Wednesday weekly meeting the response by Singapore's Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong to Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew's remarks on Johor, said Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.
-- Applications for foreign maids will be approved within a week once the Immigration Department revises its procedures, the department's deputy director-general Aseh Che Mat said.
